documents.title: 2023 Emissions Report
documents.text: Scope 1 and Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions cover direct emissions from owned and operated facilities and indirect emissions from purchased energy. The company reduced Scope 1 emissions by 18 percent against the 2019 baseline.

documents.title: Renewable Energy Procurement
documents.text: The company signed long term power purchase agreements for 240 megawatts of renewable electricity, covering the electricity consumption of six manufacturing sites in three countries.

documents.title: Water Stewardship Programme
documents.text: A water stewardship programme targets the basins where the largest withdrawals occur, with recycling raised to 41 percent of total water use at the desert assembly plants.

documents.title: Supplier Code of Conduct
documents.text: The supplier code of conduct requires every supplier to respect human rights, avoid forced labour and report safety incidents within 24 hours of occurrence.

documents.title: Workplace Safety
documents.text: The total recordable incident rate fell to 0.34 per 200,000 hours worked. Safety training completion reached 99 percent of all employees and contractors.

documents.title: Product Quality Assurance
documents.text: Quality assurance covers incoming inspection, in process testing and final audit. A batch traceability system lets a recall be scoped to a single production lot within two hours.

documents.title: Distribution Network
documents.text: The distribution network serves 1,400 distribution centres. Route optimisation and a shift of two thirds of volume to rail reduced tonne kilometres per unit shipped.

documents.title: Packaging and Recycling
documents.text: All primary packaging is now recyclable and the company removed 4,100 tonnes of plastic per year by light weighting bottles and replacing shrink film with stretch wrap.

documents.title: Learning and Development
documents.text: Every employee receives an annual learning budget and 42 hours of training. A graduate programme placed 380 new hires into engineering and data roles.

documents.title: Cyber Security Operations
documents.text: A security operations centre monitors the network around the clock. Phishing simulation training reduced the click rate from 19 percent to 4 percent.

documents.title: Clinical Development
documents.text: Phase three trials for the lead candidate met the primary endpoint. The programme enrolled 2,140 participants across 34 sites in 11 countries.

documents.title: Intellectual Property
documents.text: The company holds 3,900 granted patents and 1,200 pending applications, covering formulation, delivery devices and manufacturing process control.
